generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Before commencing the work all the materials should be get inspected and certificate to be obtained regarding quality of materials by T.A. & Q.C. Wing, Hescom. At own cost of contractors
You have to obtain certificate from T.A. & Q.C. Wing, After completion of the work.
You have to obtain approval from the Govt. Electrical Inspectorate.

Bidder can access tender documents on the website, fill them and submit the completed tender document into electronic tender on the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in after submitting the EMD and tender processing fee in the form of e-payment. EMD will be refunded only after acceptance of successful bidder.

If the rates quoted by the contractor is lesser than the amount put to tender, the difference cost should be paid by the contractor, through DD/ FDR/NSC in the favour of Commissioner VUDA at the time of agreement.
Any damage during the progress of work, the damage cost should be beared by the contractor.
Tender application cost will not be refundable or exchangeable in case of cancellation of tender.
All materials should be in good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost.

The work should be carried out in accordance with the standard specifications specified by the department and as per the direction of the Engineer incharge of work. Maintenance period from the contractor for the above works is 2 year from the date of completion of work.
Security deposit at the rate of 5% of tender cost should be made in favour of Commissioner VUDA in the form of DD/FDR/NSC (NSC should be fledge in the name of Commissioner)
Acceptance/ Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.
Contractor should follow labour department guidelines.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period at contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by authority while granting is extension of time.
All terms and conditions are as per the tender notification and KW-2

itemList.description: Fabrication, Supplying, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of . ms long Polygon high mast with Single/Multiple telescopic sections having, (minimum overlap distance of 1.5 times of top section) thickness as per BSEN 10025 grades 355 JO/ASTM A572-50 steel sheet plate for shaft suitable to withstand a wind velocity of 47 m/s as per IS 875 part 3(as per GA Drawing). Base plate as per IS 2062/ASTM A572-50. The mast shall be Galvanized in single Hot-dip as per BSEN ISO 1461/ASTM A123 with an average 70 microns as per IS 2629, and welded as per BS 5135 Single L-Seam joint The mast shall have 2 Way head frame with die cast LM-6 pulleys, stainless steel axle, Phosphorus Bronze bearing bush press-fitted with separate guides for 2 runs of 5 mm dia, stainless steel wire rope of AISI 304grade 7/19-core, (Factor of Safety as per TR no-7). 2.5 mm2 EPR insulated PCP sheathed trailing power cable housed inside the bottom shaft of mast with door having locking arrangement The mast shall have manual/power tool (Suitable reversible geared motor operating on 230/415V, 50Hz, shall be provide above 15 Mtr mast) The mast shall have lantern of 2 segments, suitable dia with max load carrying capacity as per IS 1239. The mast shall be erected on existing RCC footing. The mast shall be supplied with 3 mm thick template, lightning arrester of 1.2m length galvanized pipe with top arrow fitted on top of the head frame cover and GLS type aviation twin l A fitting with wiring complete. (excluding foundation) as per technical data. - 12 m/12.5 m - Top 100 mm and Bottom 310 mm dia (PWD Ele 2023-24, P.No.12 & 13, I.No.4.5.1, V-6)
